title: 03. Embeddings & Vector DBs: ChromaDB WITH LangChain
summary: ChromaDB WITH LangChain: explanations and runnable examples.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```python name=00_theory/04_chroma_with_langchain.py
"""
CHAPTER 4: ChromaDB with LangChain

LangChain wraps ChromaDB into its VectorStore interface,
giving you a consistent API across all vector stores.

Key import:
  from langchain_chroma import Chroma

LangChain auto-handles:
  - Embedding generation (via your chosen embeddings model)
  - Document wrapping (LangChain Document objects)
  - ID management
  - Retriever interface

Install:
  pip install langchain langchain-chroma langchain-openai chromadb
"""

import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from langchain_openai import OpenAIEmbeddings
from langchain_chroma import Chroma
from langchain_core.documents import Document

load_dotenv()

CHROMA_DB_PATH = "./chroma_db/langchain_demo"

embeddings = OpenAIEmbeddings(
    model="text-embedding-3-large",
    api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4.1 CREATE A PERSISTENT CHROMA STORE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
docs = [
    Document(page_content="LangChain simplifies building LLM applications.", metadata={"topic": "langchain", "level": "beginner"}),
    Document(page_content="ChromaDB is an open-source vector database.", metadata={"topic": "chromadb", "level": "beginner"}),
    Document(page_content="OpenAI embeddings produce dense vector representations.", metadata={"topic": "openai", "level": "intermediate"}),
    Document(page_content="RAG combines retrieval with generation for accurate answers.", metadata={"topic": "rag", "level": "intermediate"}),
    Document(page_content="LangChain Expression Language (LCEL) allows composable chains.", metadata={"topic": "langchain", "level": "advanced"}),
]

# Create and persist
vs = Chroma.from_documents(
    documents=docs,
    embedding=embeddings,
    collection_name="langchain_demo",
    persist_directory=CHROMA_DB_PATH,
    collection_metadata={"hnsw:space": "cosine"},
)
print(f"✅ Created store with {vs._collection.count()} documents")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4.2 LOAD EXISTING STORE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
vs_loaded = Chroma(
    collection_name="langchain_demo",
    embedding_function=embeddings,
    persist_directory=CHROMA_DB_PATH,
)
print(f"📂 Loaded store: {vs_loaded._collection.count()} docs")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4.3 ADD MORE DOCUMENTS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
more_docs = [
    Document(page_content="FAISS is a fast similarity search library from Facebook.", metadata={"topic": "faiss", "level": "beginner"}),
    Document(page_content="Pinecone is a managed cloud vector database service.", metadata={"topic": "pinecone", "level": "beginner"}),
]
ids = vs.add_documents(more_docs)
print(f"➕ Added docs. IDs: {ids}")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4.4 DELETE DOCUMENTS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LangChain Chroma supports delete by ID
if ids:
    vs.delete(ids=[ids[0]])
    print(f"🗑️  Deleted: {ids[0]}")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4.5 UPDATE DOCUMENTS (delete + re-add with same ID)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
target_id = ids[1] if len(ids) > 1 else None
if target_id:
    vs.delete(ids=[target_id])
    updated_doc = Document(
        page_content="Pinecone is a fully managed, production-ready cloud vector database.",
        metadata={"topic": "pinecone", "level": "intermediate", "updated": True},
    )
    vs.add_documents([updated_doc], ids=[target_id])
    print(f"✏️  Updated: {target_id}")

print(f"\n📊 Final doc count: {vs._collection.count()}")
```
